integrity: Exhaustive 711-face enumeration, acyclic matching on 710 nonempty faces, exact signed integral Morse differentials, Smith forms, independent unit-pivot reduction and homotopy argument. Standalone Python/SymPy programs included.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the 7-vertex fully bidirected K_{2,5} only; no statement about larger branch counts or all complete bipartite digraphs. Bibliographic exclusion is not proof of global novelty.
title: A Moore-space summand in the five-branch bidirected theta multipath complex
